sentence: This project studies how the growth of endothelial cells, which line blood vessels, is controlled and how it shapes arterial-venous network development.
This project uses an in vitro model of the human lung to find risk variants for a severe response to acute ozone exposure.
This project studies how organelles fuse and make contact with each other, which is needed for autophagosome biogenesis.
This project tests whether cell-free DNA methylation patterns in peripheral blood match glioblastoma tumor biology and how patients respond to treatment.
This project studies how a skin molecule helps defend against oxidative damage and how losing it leads to fat loss throughout the body.
This project builds a cone beam CT platform that combines a photon counting detector and a flat panel detector to show soft tissue better.
This project studies how neural circuits control complex behavior and how odors change locomotion.
This project works out the pathways that link genetic variants in a gene to chronic kidney disease.
This project uses mass spectrometry and in vitro exposure systems to study the chemical composition and toxicity of 6-methyl nicotine and nicotinamide vapes.
This project builds an intravascular imaging system that combines optical coherence tomography, ultrasound and photoacoustic tomography to look at coronary artery disease.
This project studies which brain circuits are involved in spatial memory problems during virtual navigation in children with prenatal alcohol exposure.
This project studies how the brain organizes its activity for bimanual coordination and how this breaks down in a mouse model of Parkinson’s disease.
This project studies risk factors for progressive chronic kidney disease in patients on molecularly targeted cancer therapies.
This project adds epigenomic studies to a diagnostic workflow to find methylation-related disorders in families with rare undiagnosed diseases.
This project develops an artificial intelligence computer vision method to measure what youth do on social media.
This project uses functional genomic assays to find common genetic factors that interact with phthalates and affect endothelial function and cardiovascular health.
This project develops ultrasensitive DNA sequencing methods to detect cancer-relevant mutations and methylation patterns in clinical specimens.
This project studies how transcranial alternating current stimulation changes neuronal activity and working memory in an experimental model of Alzheimer’s disease.
This project studies whether gangliosides affect alcohol-associated liver disease through gut sialylation and microbial metabolites.
